_comment: Stage C keys are (layout_id, orbital_phase). A generation dispatches 8 DISTINCT pairs (plan.md 7.1) - this is the demo grid. Two held-out axes: unseen LAYOUTS (10, 11, inherited from Stage B) and unseen PHASES on training layouts. Report both separately: a policy that generalises across phase but not across layout has learned the choreography, not the physics.

dispatch.rule: sample 8 distinct layout_ids from `train`, each with a freshly sampled orbital_phase
dispatch.base_seed: one base seed per generation; episode seed = base_seed + worker_id, which also seeds action sampling
dispatch.note: Phase is resampled every generation even for a repeated layout, so no world is ever seen twice identically.
